tagline.zh: 潜行与近战爆发，控制手段多，PVP 主动性强。
tagline.en: Stealthy melee burst and control; proactive in PvP.

strengths.zh: 爆发高、控制多、能跳过不想打的怪。
strengths.en: High burst, rich control, can skip unwanted fights.

drawbacks.zh: 容错低，对走位和时机要求高。
drawbacks.en: Low margin for error; demands positioning and timing.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
provenance.notes: Class list and roles per Blizzard class deep-dive posts; tree data extracted from beta client.
